LanguageData.Megamod_Search_SortHelp: Group and sort pages in Options → Mod options. Turning this off leaves individual-option search available.
LanguageData.Megamod_Search_EnabledHelp: Find individual options across active mods by label, help, value or owner. Results open the original settings controls.
LanguageData.Megamod_Search_Incomplete: {0} pages have incomplete or unavailable option data.
LanguageData.Megamod_Search_PageUnavailable: This settings page is no longer available. Refresh the list.
LanguageData.Megamod_Search_RevealUnavailable: This option cannot currently be revealed. You can navigate its original page manually.
LanguageData.Megamod_Search_QueryHelp: Search labels, help, values and owners. Combine words, use "phrases", -exclusions, or mod:, author:, id: and tab: filters.
LanguageData.Megamod_Search_Timing_NextEligibleOccurr: Applies at the next eligible action.
LanguageData.Megamod_Search_Timing_NewGameOrLoad: Applies when starting or loading a colony.
LanguageData.Megamod_Search_StatusPartial: Some options may not have been captured.
LanguageData.Megamod_Search_StatusCancelled: Reading cancelled; captured results are retained.
LanguageData.Megamod_Search_StatusFailed: Options could not be read. Open this page to browse them manually.
LanguageData.Megamod_Search_ReasonBudget: Reading stopped at its work or memory limit.
LanguageData.Megamod_Search_ReasonUnsupported: This page uses controls or a settings window that cannot currently be read.
LanguageData.Megamod_Search_ReasonChanged: The page changed while it was being read. Refresh to try again.
LanguageData.Megamod_Search_ReasonCallback: The page failed while its settings were being read.
LanguageData.Megamod_Search_CatalogFailed: The settings list could not be read. Native page browsing remains available.
